account.title: Account
account.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface

quickSettings.title: Quick Settings
quickSettings.sendByCtrlEnterDescription: When enabled, pressing Ctrl+Enter will send the message instead of just Enter. This is useful for IME users to avoid accidental sends.

dragHandle.toggleAndMove: Click to toggle, drag to move

fleet.securityNote: Only public fingerprints and operational state are shown. Private keys, token hashes, peer URLs, and sensitive paths never appear here.

identity.title: This PC
identity.description: Public installation identity used to pin trusted peers.

enroll.title: Add a PC
enroll.description: Generate a code on the PC being added, then enter its endpoint and code here.
enroll.roleConflict: This PC is enrolled under another hub. Revoke that hub grant before using this PC as a hub. Direct local recovery remains available.
enroll.label: Host label

modes.directHelp: Use Tailscale Serve or another trusted TLS endpoint ending in /fleet-ws. Plaintext is rejected.
modes.sshHelp: Create an owner-managed SSH local forward first. Only ws://127.0.0.1 or ws://[::1] ending in /fleet-ws is accepted; ChatMux never downgrades automatically.

hosts.title: Enrolled hosts
hosts.description: Connection health and negotiated machine capabilities. A fleet supports ten PCs total.

confirm.title: Confirm peer revocation
confirm.description: The hub removes local authorization first, then asks the peer to revoke this hub grant. Remote revocation may report unreachable separately.

sshEasy.title: Easy SSH setup
sshEasy.description: ChatMux connects over SSH, sets up the secure tunnel, and enrolls the PC automatically.
sshEasy.passwordHelp: Used only for this connection and never saved.
sshEasy.keyDisclosure: On first connect, ChatMux installs an SSH key restricted to this hub on the remote PC. Later reconnects are automatic.

errors.INVALID_SSH_TARGET: Enter a valid SSH target as user@host[:port].
errors.MALFORMED_REQUEST: The SSH enrollment request is malformed.
errors.SSH_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: The SSH password is required for the first connection.
errors.SSH_AUTH_FAILED: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and password.
errors.SSH_UNREACHABLE: The SSH target could not be reached.
errors.HOSTKEY_REJECTED: The host key was rejected. Verify the remote PC identity.
errors.REMOTE_CLI_FAILED: ChatMux could not run on the remote PC.
errors.TOKEN_PARSE_FAILED: The remote pairing token could not be read.
errors.ENROLL_FAILED: The PC could not be enrolled.
errors.PEER_LIMIT_REACHED: This fleet already has the maximum number of PCs.
errors.TUNNEL_FAILED: The secure SSH tunnel could not be established.

blockedTools.description: Tools that are automatically blocked without prompting for permission

allowedCommands.description: Shell commands that are automatically allowed without prompting

blockedCommands.title: Blocked Shell Commands
blockedCommands.description: Shell commands that are automatically blocked

codex.description: Controls how Codex handles file modifications and command execution

default.title: Default
default.description: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.

acceptEdits.title: Accept Edits
acceptEdits.description: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.

bypassPermissions.title: Bypass Permissions
bypassPermissions.description: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.

technicalInfo.default: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=untrusted. Trusted commands: cat, cd, grep, head, ls, pwd, tail, git status/log/diff/show, find (without -exec), etc.
technicalInfo.acceptEdits: sandboxMode=workspace-write, approvalPolicy=never. All commands auto-execute within project directory.
technicalInfo.bypassPermissions: sandboxMode=danger-full-access, approvalPolicy=never. Full system access, use only in trusted environments.
technicalInfo.overrideNote: You can override this per-session using the mode button in the chat interface.
